summary: Serializable Action Specs and validated invocation contracts; execution and Asset publication use the shared Durable Run and Asset authority contracts.
context_hints: Start here when adding or changing an action; UI components and endpoints are adapters, not the contract.
Invocation mode is derived from the originating surface: Canvas is explicit, Asset Preview is implicit.
Read docs/action-spec-system.md only for its ActionSpec/UI-intent context; read apps/docs/guide/durable-run-protocol.md and apps/docs/guide/asset-system.md for current execution and Asset semantics.

key_files.spec.ts: Generic serializable ActionSpec and surface/mode schemas.
key_files.asset-edit.ts: Built-in image/video edit specs, typed invocations, output resolution, and compatibility helpers.
key_files.asset-edit.test.ts: Executable invariants for action discovery, representation, and output kinds.

architecture_notes: Specs contain data only. Executor functions belong to runtime adapters. Successful media actions publish immutable Resources as ProjectAsset entries plus ActionAssetBinding lineage; storage keys and URLs are never product identity.
